children: India's services exports rose 7.2% year-on-year to $39.3 billion in September 2026, while imports increased 12.6% to $20.1 billion, according to provisional data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
The growth in services exports moderated from 13.7% in August and 13.4% in July. Import growth also eased to 12.6% in September from 21.4% in August and 19.1% in July.
On a month-on-month basis, services exports increased to $39.3 billion in September from $35.47 billion in August, while imports rose to $20.1 billion from $18.93 billion.
India recorded a services trade surplus of $19.2 billion in September, higher than the $16.5 billion surplus in August and $17.6 billion in July.
The figures for July-September 2026 are provisional. Growth rates have been revised based on balance of payments statistics.

title: India’s services exports rise 7.2% to $39.3 billion in September, imports grow 12.6%
